vb_textbox.text: If a colour is high scoring, try to chose that gnome again for about 3 times in all, after which the scores tend to go down, so switch to another choice.  After the gnome has had some time out (picking mushrooms in the forest!) the score will go up again for that colour, so it will be a good choice again. I tried to give each color a break like this, and also wondered if the brown and maroon coloured gnomes both went up and down at roughly the same times, so tended to go for both of these if one of them was on the up.
